description: This Java abstract class defines a base for policy adapter implementations within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter framework. It manages pattern matching for policy-related paths, holds a signal mapper, and includes a method to map signals to adaptables.

classes.name: AbstractPolicyAdapter
classes.description: An abstract class for policy-related adapters that handle signals, utilizing pattern matching for policy paths and mapping signals to adaptables.

methods.name: AbstractPolicyAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the policy adapter with mapping strategies, a signal mapper, and a header translator.

methods.name: mapSignalToAdaptable
methods.description: Maps a given signal to an adaptable object using the provided SignalMapper.
